report.summary: Recognizable and charming apartment miniature: the broad hipped roof, paired brick entrance projections, stacked central balconies, twin north-facing dormers, and brick/siding/cream-trim palette form a coherent caricature. No obvious visible construction defect compromises the model.

orientation.summary: The map defines the west facade as -u. Located SV2 views that face and shows the characteristic west-side red-door entrance groups; SV3 supports the southern end of the same frontage. The rendered inventory places all five doors on -u—two on each projecting entrance wing plus central balcony access—and none on +u, +v, or -v. The labeled -u render is partly obstructed, but its visible frontage and the overview agree with this placement, while -v correctly carries the twin north-facing dormers.
